hero.title: Far above Cayuga’s waters, and right here in Delhi.
hero.lead: The Cornell Club of Delhi brings together alumni, students, parents and friends of Cornell University across the National Capital Region.

whatWeDo.title: Staying connected to Cornell, together
whatWeDo.intro: Whether you graduated last spring or decades ago, there’s a place for you here.

cards.title: Social gatherings
cards.text: Monthly meetups, festive celebrations and an annual gala for Cornellians and their families.

cards.title: Professional network
cards.text: Panels, mentoring and introductions across industries, from policy and finance to tech and hospitality.

cards.title: Future Cornellians
cards.text: Send-off parties for admitted students and alumni interviews for applicants from the region.

community.title: Any person, any study, any city
community.text: Ezra Cornell’s founding vision was an institution where any person can find instruction in any study. Our club carries that spirit into Delhi, welcoming every Cornellian, whatever their college, class year or career path.
community.quote: “I would found an institution where any person can find instruction in any study.”

upcoming.title: Next on the calendar
upcoming.empty: Our next gatherings are being planned. Check back soon.

cta.title: Are you a Cornellian in Delhi?
cta.text: Get on our mailing list for event invitations and club news.

contact.location: New Delhi, India · serving Delhi, Gurugram, Noida and NCR
